Opposition Parties Petition Chief Justice Over Election Commission's SIR Process

Twenty-three opposition parties, including the DMK and AAP, have jointly written to the Chief Justice of India regarding the Election Commission's 'SIR process'. The letter raises concerns about the Election Commission's neutrality. This action occurred despite some parties not attending a recent INDIA bloc meeting.
